background.description: Plain light-coloured background (white preferred), recent colour passport-style photo

notes: Verified against the official CRP PO/MT-XVI notification (Annexure III), dated 30 June 2026: photo dimensions 200x230 pixels (preferred), 20-50 KB, JPEG. Note that IBPS additionally requires capturing a live photograph via webcam or mobile during the application, on top of this uploaded file — this preset only covers the pre-made file upload, not that separate live-capture step.
